verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party Outlook feature for exporting all of a user's data in open formats. The Graph API's ability to read and synchronize messages is a developer building block a programmer could use to build an export, not the export capability itself. The community-mentioned readpst/libpst conversion of .pst to mbox is a third-party user workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Synchronize messages or mail folder hierarchy
